5 sample questions

1. In Oklahoma, how many questions are on the written exam for a learner permit?

  1. 10
  2. 20 (correct answer)
  3. 30
  4. 50

Answer: B. In Oklahoma, the written exam for a learner permit has 20 questions.

2. In Oklahoma, may a driver read or send a text message on a hand-held phone while driving?

  1. Yes, at a slow speed
  2. Yes, on rural roads
  3. Yes, if the message is short
  4. No, it is against the law (correct answer)

Answer: D. In Oklahoma, it is against the law to text on a hand-held phone while driving.

Oklahoma handbook, page 61.

3. In Oklahoma, what is the fine for a first violation of the Move Over law?

  1. $1,000 (correct answer)
  2. $50
  3. $100
  4. $250

Answer: A. In Oklahoma, a first violation of the Move Over law carries a fine of $1,000.

4. In Oklahoma, a school bus stops with red lights flashing on a four-lane road with a center turn lane and no median. Who must stop?

  1. Only traffic behind the bus
  2. Only traffic in the lane next to the bus
  3. All traffic in both directions (correct answer)
  4. No one, because of the turn lane

Answer: C. In Oklahoma, on a road with four or more lanes and no median, traffic in both directions must stop for a stopped school bus, even if there is a center turn lane.

Oklahoma handbook, page 30.

5. In Oklahoma, what must a 15-year-old be doing to get a learner permit?

  1. Working a part-time job
  2. Nothing extra; age is enough
  3. Holding a high school diploma
  4. Taking an approved driver education course (correct answer)

Answer: D. In Oklahoma, a 15-year-old must be enrolled in and taking an approved driver education course, and must pass the written exam, to get a learner permit.

Oklahoma handbook, page 6.
